mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (target_board, author_id, title, content) VALUES (#{targetBoard}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.author_id, u.name AS authorName, n.created_at, n.views, n.is_pinned FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.target_board = #{targetBoard} AND n.is_active = 1 ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.author_id, u.name AS authorName, n.created_at, n.views FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.is_active = 1
